# Templates

> Ready-to-copy project scaffolds and boilerplate patterns for common use cases.

!!! warning "Coming soon"
    Templates are [Copier](https://copier.readthedocs.io/) project scaffolds that
    generate a canonical blkit-based project. They depend on the library's
    decision and process APIs, which are still being built, so there are no
    templates yet.

    For now, see [Getting started](../getting-started/index.md) and the
    [Reference](../reference/blkit.md).
